# TDscript Core 1.1 / TDModules v1.4.0 — Full Technical Specification for AI & LLM Systems
> Comprehensive technical guide and normative architecture for TDscript, TDscript Studio IDE, and TDRobotics.
> Author: Anton Mykhailov (Halberstadt, Germany)
> Canonical Repository: TDModules (v1.4.0) & TDscript-Studio (v1.1.0)
> Website: https://fido2465724100-creator.github.io/my-developer-site/
> AI-First Language Portal: https://fido2465724100-creator.github.io/my-developer-site/tdscript/ai-language.html
> Benchmark (Test #3 & Test #4): https://fido2465724100-creator.github.io/my-developer-site/tdscript/benchmark.html

---

## 1. System Philosophy & Core Constraints

1. **0 KB VRAM / Headless First**:
   TDscript runs deterministically on bare-metal headless microcontrollers, Android TUI services, background system daemons, and robotics controllers without requiring any GPU context, X11/Wayland display server, or GUI thread.
2. **Deterministic Single-Threaded Worker**:
   Core VM executes in a single-threaded loop with a unified Script Global Scope (variables declared inside `{ ... }` blocks remain globally accessible within the script instance).
3. **Execution Step Limiter (Fail-Safe)**:
   Every statement and while-iteration decrements an execution budget (`maxSteps = 10_000_000L`). If a runaway loop occurs, the host immediately triggers `host.emergencyStop()` and throws `TDS_E106_STEP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.
4. **Grammatical Safety across 109 Languages**:
   All string literals and comments are completely decoupled from keyword translation. Direct string concatenation (`+`) with localized `LString` instances is forbidden by runtime assertion to prevent broken gender/case inflections across languages (throws `TDS_E105_LSTRING_CONCAT_PROHIBITED`).

---

## 2. Capabilities Security Bitmask (16 Flags)

Every TDscript execution environment enforces capability checks through `HostSPI.checkCapability(bit, name)`. If an unauthorized script attempts an operation without the required bitmask, the host denies execution and records `SecurityException: PERMISSION_DENIED [CAP_NAME]` in the diagnostic channel.

| Flag Name | Bitmask (Hex) | Governed Operations & Subsystems |
|:---|:---:|:---|
| `NET_READ` | `0x0001` | HTTP GET queries, DNS lookups, ICMP ping |
| `NET_SCAN` | `0x0002` | TCP port scanning, ARP/Subnet network discovery |
| `PLC_READ` | `0x0004` | Reading Modbus TCP/RTU input and holding registers |
| `PLC_WRITE` | `0x0008` | Writing Modbus TCP/RTU coil and holding registers |
| `BT_ACCESS` | `0x0010` | Bluetooth Classic (SPP) and BLE GATT communications |
| `HARDWARE` | `0x0020` | Smartphone flashlight, vibrator, camera, GPS, battery |
| `UI_CORE` | `0x0040` | Rendering TUI windows, operator progress bars, alerts |
| `BACKGROUND` | `0x0080` | Persistent background daemon execution (Watchdog Service) |
| `I2C_READ` | `0x0100` | Reading integrated circuit registers over I2C bus |
| `I2C_WRITE` | `0x0200` | Writing configuration bytes to ICs over I2C bus |
| `SPI_TRANSFER` | `0x0400` | Full-duplex synchronous SPI transactions |
| `SERIAL_RAW` | `0x0800` | Direct raw access to COM/TTY ports and USB-UART converters |
| `CAN_BUS` | `0x1000` | Receiving and transmitting automotive/industrial CAN frames |
| `ROBOT_MOTION` | `0x2000` | Kinematic planning commands (moveLinear, moveJoint, grip) |
| `ROBOT_OVERRIDE` | `0x4000` | High-priority safety intervention and programmatic E-Stop |
| `DRIVER_INSTALL` | `0x8000` | Dynamic installation and verification of driver manifests |

---

## 3. Spatial Sandboxing: CapabilityScope Specification

Beyond global bitmask privileges, TDscript Core 1.1 enforces spatial parameter sandboxing via `CapabilityScope`. The host verifies exact physical addresses and port names before executing bus transactions:

```kotlin
data class CapabilityScope(
    val allowedI2cAddresses: Set<Int> = emptySet(),           // e.g. setOf(0x76) for Bosch BME280
    val allowedModbusRegisterRanges: List<IntRange> = emptyList(), // e.g. listOf(100..200)
    val allowedSerialPorts: Set<String> = emptySet(),         // e.g. setOf("/dev/ttyUSB0", "COM3")
    val isUnrestricted: Boolean = false
)
```

- If a script calls `I2C.read(104, 0, 1)` (0x68) when `allowedI2cAddresses = setOf(0x76)`:
  - The host intercepts the call.
  - The call returns `null`.
  - Diagnostic channel logs: `SecurityException: SCOPE_VIOLATION: Address 0x68 not in I2C scope`.

---

## 4. Native Multilingual Architecture (109 Languages)

1. **Directive `language: <code>;`**:
   Placed at line 1 of any script file.
   Examples: `language: ru;`, `language: de;`, `language: es;`.
2. **Lexer Mapping**:
   The lexer converts localized keywords into standard AST tokens at parse time:
   - Russian: `пусть` / `перем` -> `LET` / `VAR`; `если` / `иначе` -> `IF` / `ELSE`; `пока` -> `WHILE`; `истина` / `ложь` -> `TRUE` / `FALSE`.
   - German: `sei` -> `LET`; `wenn` / `sonst` -> `IF` / `ELSE`; `solange` -> `WHILE`; `wahr` / `falsch` -> `TRUE` / `FALSE`.
3. **State-Machine CodeProjector**:
   Ensures that words matching keywords inside string literals (e.g. `"if true and while false"`) or comments (`// while true`, `/* if false */`) are strictly left unchanged during display projection.
4. **LString Symbolic Resources**:
   - Declaration: `let msg = L"MSG_TEMP:Temperature is {temp}C"`
   - Evaluation: Automatically substitutes `{temp}` from active symbols.
   - Guard: `left is LString || right is LString` with operator `+` throws `TDS_E105_LSTRING_CONCAT_PROHIBITED`.

---

## 5. Autonomous AI Agentic Loop in TDscript Studio

The TDscript Studio IDE features a self-healing agent loop:
1. **Hardware Discovery (`probe()`)**:
   Studio queries active physical and virtual adapters and generates machine-readable discovery JSON:
   ```json
   {
     "runtime": { "name": "TDscript Studio AI Environment", "version": "1.1.0" },
     "capabilities": {
       "active": ["I2C_READ", "I2C_WRITE", "PLC_READ", "PLC_WRITE", "SERIAL_RAW"],
       "scope_summary": "I2C: [0x76], Modbus: [100..200]"
     },
     "hardware_adapters": [
       { "id": "sim_i2c_0", "type": "I2C", "available": true, "details": "Virtual I2C Bus (BME280 @ 0x76)" },
       { "id": "sim_modbus_tcp", "type": "NETWORK_TCP", "available": true, "details": "Virtual Modbus PLC Gateway @ 127.0.0.1:502" }
     ]
   }
   ```
2. **Prompt Injection & Generation**:
   The discovery JSON and grammar memo are injected into the system prompt. The model generates code wrapped in a ` ```tdscript ` block.
3. **Execution in `AiHardwareSandbox`**:
   The code is parsed and executed against the virtual sandbox:
   - Bosch BME280 @ address 0x76: Chip ID `0x60` in register `0xD0`.
   - Modbus PLC Gateway @ 127.0.0.1:502: Register 100 = 245 (24.5°C), Register 101 = 1 (Pump ON).
4. **Auto-Fix Loop via `CompilerErrorDiagnostic`**:
   If an error occurs, Studio formats structured diagnostic JSON:
   ```json
   {
     "status": "ERROR",
     "compiler_version": "1.1.0",
     "error_code": "SCOPE_VIOLATION",
     "file": "script.tds",
     "line": 4,
     "column": 1,
     "message": "SecurityException: SCOPE_VIOLATION: Address 0x68 not in I2C scope",
     "expected": "Access only to allowed addresses in CapabilityScope",
     "actual": "Attempted read from 0x68",
     "suggestion": "Use granted BME280 address 0x76 (118 in decimal)"
   }
   ```
   The diagnostic is sent back to the LLM with an instruction to repair the script (up to 3–5 iterations).

---

## 6. Complete Language Syntax & API Reference

### 6.1. Core Syntax
```javascript
language: ru;

// Variable declarations
let sensorId = 118;
var alertCount = 0;

// Branching
if (sensorId == 118) {
    alertCount = alertCount + 1;
} else {
    alertCount = 0;
}

// Loops with automatic step limiter protection
var i = 0;
while (i < 5) {
    i = i + 1;
}
```

### 6.2. Peripheral & Bus Methods
- `I2C.read(address: Int, register: Int, length: Int) -> ByteArray?` (in v1.4.0 supports hex literals e.g. `0x76`, `0xD0`)
- `I2C.write(address: Int, register: Int, data: Any) -> Boolean` (in v1.4.0 supports `I2C.write(0x76, 0xF4, 0x27)`)
- `SERIAL.read(port: String, maxLength: Int) -> ByteArray?`
- `SERIAL.write(port: String, data: ByteArray) -> Boolean`
- `PLC.modbusRead(host: String, register: Int) -> Int`
- `PLC.modbusWrite(host: String, register: Int, value: Int) -> Boolean`
- `BLE.connect(deviceId: String) -> Boolean`
- `BLE.send(deviceId: String, cmd: String) -> String`
- `NET.ping(host: String) -> Int`
- `WATCHDOG.feed() -> Boolean`
- `WATCHDOG.emergencyStop() -> Unit`
- `print(value: Any?) -> Unit` (in v1.4.0 formats ByteArray deterministically as `[0x60]`)

### 6.3. Version Compatibility: v1.4.0 (Studio) vs v1.0.1 (Legacy)
- **v1.4.0 / Core 1.1**: Hexadecimal literals (`0x76`, `0xD0`), `ByteArray[i]` indexing, `LString` interpolation `{var}`, strict method dispatch (`TDS_E106`), `WATCHDOG`, compact repair lines (`E104@line:col`), GBNF grammar.
- **v1.0.1 / Core 1.0**: Maintained in Tdroid Android Launcher. Decimal literals only (`118`, `208`), symbolic LString without `{var}`, full multi-line JSON error diagnostics.
